card.name: Injection words in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Words like injecting, Injection, dosing, or adding in the dosage and administration section, mostly where preparation or administration steps are given and a drug name or verb is followed by how to give it.

modes.label: Injection after drug name
modes.description: The word Injection or injections right after a product name or the verb Administer.

modes.label: Preparation action verbs
modes.description: Verbs or word endings describing reconstituting, dosing, or giving the product.
modes.example: Reconstitute two (2) vials of Mycophenolate Mofetil for Injection by<< injecting>> 14 mL of 5%
